description: BIDSvue ingest-stage UI app. Launched by NeuroFlow with a session context, it imports DICOMs into a BIDS dataset under the session output directory while the user drives series filtering and BIDS metadata in the UI.

subject.description: BIDS subject label seed (the user may override in the UI).

bids_dir.description: The BIDS dataset the user produced in BIDSvue.

block.label: Ingest in BIDSvue
block.description: Import DICOMs into BIDS, driven interactively by the user.

neuroflow/launch.description: BIDSvue reads $NEUROFLOW_SESSION/context.json, imports inputs.dicom_dir into $NEUROFLOW_OUTPUT_DIR/bids, then writes neuroflow.handoff.json and appends provenance.jsonl when the user finishes.
